name: night-read-l9-crawl
note: E31-AC16 crawl-away read at the L9 crash site: the courier moves from the crawl start beside the wrecked APC along the road to the crawl end (Scene Lab has no crawl pose or 0 HP state: running stands in; the e2e T-E31-16 owns those states).
